title: misc-design-asset-dump-temp
content:
Quick dump of assorted design, meme, and placeholder assets dropped into _temp_uploads. This is intentionally messy — use for ad-hoc slides, internal demos, or to lock down a file that someone might have asked for.

Files included (local filenames — not uploaded to CDN):
- redwood-mascot-sketch-v3.png (raster, 1200x1200, transparent background)
- courier-meme-001.jpg (jpeg, lazy caption: "when the batch size hits 1024")
- weird-hex-badge.svg (vector, experimental icon system)
- draft-favicon-collection.zip (multiple sizes)
- placeholder-background-gradient.psd (contains layers named "do-not-delete")

Notes / provenance:
- Some assets were pulled from a community icon pack (license: SIL Open Font License-ish — verify before external use).
- The mascot sketch is a quick iteration from a contractor; do not use in external marketing without approval.
- Several files contain text layers labeled "WIP_COPY" — these are definitely temporary.

Action items / TODO (low priority):
- [ ] Confirm licensing on community icons (owner: @Marco Ruiz).
- [ ] Export favicon sizes and upload to CDN (owner: Jin Park).
- [ ] Run mascot sketch past brand for approval before any public-facing use.

Random developer notes (copied from Slack snippets):
- "Does anyone have a PNG of the old logo? I need it for a demo."
- "If we’re memeing about inference cost, use the courier-meme-001.jpg but crop to 16:9."

Usage guidance:
- This folder is ephemeral. If an asset is needed longer-term, move to confluence/eng-sre/brand-assets or the official design drive.
- If you see file names with timestamps like "20250210" assume the date is when it was dropped in.

Misc scribbles (leave as-is — deliberately chaotic):
- color tests: #0F172A / #7C3AED / gradient-ish
- font experiments: Inter var + source-sans-pro fallback
- odd note: "try orange for CTA? maybe not."

If you’re reading this and need something specific, ping Aisha (owner) or drop a comment in the file. This doc is a temporary catch-all and will be pruned periodically.
